items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19

ctx.x: 1925. Okay. So can you, can you tell me all of your brothers and sisters, can you, can you give them an order? Yeah. Okay.

Okay. Uh, the brother that was killed before, long before I was born was named, uh, Levi. Uh, the next older brother was Lionel. Mm-hmm. Then there was Centel, which is a name that I had never heard before. S-E-N-T-E-L. S-E-N-T-E-L. Okay. Uh, uh-huh. And then I had a sister by the name of Louise. A sister by the name of Inez. Uh, brother. No, I had another sister by the name, another name that was strange, Maritha. Mm-hmm. Instead of Doretha, Maritha. Mm-hmm. Uh, a brother, Virgil, uh, who was a junior. Okay.…
Now, okay, where, where, where did you grow up? What street did you grow up? Uh, Bienville
